acceptance: New module `src/wordstats/topwords.py` provides `filter_min_counts(counts, min_count)` returning only the entries whose count is at least `min_count`.
`filter_min_counts` rejects a `min_count` that is not a positive integer (zero, negative, or non-int) by raising `ValueError` with a clear message.
The child attempt creates or modifies no artifact other than `src/wordstats/topwords.py`.
The module compiles under `python3 -m compileall src`.
